import numpy as np
import xarray as xr
import weldx


def test_exact_issue_example():
    """Test the exact example from the issue description."""
    print("=== Testing exact issue example ===")
    
    # Exact code from the issue description

    success = ds.arr1.attrs == ds2.arr1.attrs
    print(f"Issue example test: {'PASS' if success else 'FAIL'}")
    return success


def test_comprehensive_scenarios():
    """Test various scenarios to ensure comprehensive fix."""
    print("\n=== Testing comprehensive scenarios ===")
    
    # Scenario 1: Multiple data variables with different attributes
    da1 = xr.DataArray(np.arange(5), name="var1", attrs={"units": "m", "desc": "first"})
    da2 = xr.DataArray(np.arange(5, 10), name="var2", attrs={"units": "kg", "desc": "second"})
    ds_multi = xr.Dataset({"var1": da1, "var2": da2})
    ds_multi.attrs = {"source": "test"}
    
    ds_multi_restored = weldx.asdf.util.write_read_buffer({"ds": ds_multi})["ds"]
    
    scenario1_success = (
        ds_multi.var1.attrs == ds_multi_restored.var1.attrs and
        ds_multi.var2.attrs == ds_multi_restored.var2.attrs and
        ds_multi.attrs == ds_multi_restored.attrs
    )
    print(f"Multiple variables test: {'PASS' if scenario1_success else 'FAIL'}")
    
    # Scenario 2: Dataset with coordinates having attributes
    x_coord = xr.DataArray([1, 2, 3], dims=["x"], attrs={"axis": "x-axis"})
    y_coord = xr.DataArray([1, 2], dims=["y"], attrs={"axis": "y-axis"})
    data_var = xr.DataArray(
        np.random.rand(3, 2), 
        dims=["x", "y"], 
        attrs={"description": "random data"}
    )
    
    ds_coords = xr.Dataset(
        {"data": data_var},
        coords={"x": x_coord, "y": y_coord}
    )
    
    ds_coords_restored = weldx.asdf.util.write_read_buffer({"ds": ds_coords})["ds"]
    
    scenario2_success = (
        ds_coords.data.attrs == ds_coords_restored.data.attrs and
        ds_coords.x.attrs == ds_coords_restored.x.attrs and
        ds_coords.y.attrs == ds_coords_restored.y.attrs
    )
    print(f"Coordinate attributes test: {'PASS' if scenario2_success else 'FAIL'}")
    
    # Scenario 3: Empty and complex attributes
    da_empty = xr.DataArray([1, 2, 3], name="empty", attrs={})
    da_complex = xr.DataArray(
        [4, 5, 6], 
        name="complex", 
        attrs={"nested": {"inner": "value"}, "list": [1, 2, 3]}
    )
    ds_mixed = xr.Dataset({"empty": da_empty, "complex": da_complex})

        ds_mixed.empty.attrs == ds_mixed_restored.empty.attrs and
        set(ds_mixed.complex.attrs.keys()) == set(ds_mixed_restored.complex.attrs.keys())
    )
    print(f"Mixed attributes test: {'PASS' if scenario3_success else 'FAIL'}")
    
    return scenario1_success and scenario2_success and scenario3_success
